jurisdiction: City of Boise, Ada County, Idaho

struct.windSpeedBasis.amendment: Boise lists 90 mph from the older wind map (allowable-stress style); the app braces for about 116 mph ultimate, the up-to-115 band
struct.windSpeedBasis.note: Boise lists 90 mph from the older IRC wind figure, which is an allowable-stress (Vasd) style speed; the page does not label Vult/Vasd. 90 Vasd is about 116 Vult, so the table row for up to 115 mph Vult applies. 2018 table rows are banded (up to 110, up to 115, ...). Conversion reasoning is mine, not printed on the Boise sheet.

smoke.garageHeatAlarm.amendment: Boise City Code 9-1B-42 adds R314.7.5: a listed heat detector, wired to the smoke alarms, in attached garages (and detached ones with power that lack fire separation distance).
smoke.garageHeatAlarm.note: Boise City Code 9-1B-42, re-enacted by Ord. 3-25 (2-4-2025); in the 2026 code supplement.

design.roofSnowLoadMin.amendment: Boise's design criteria table lists a 25 psf roof snow load

design.floodHazard.value: Floodplain ordinance 12/12/1983; FIS dated 6/19/2020 (panels per Boise sheet)

notes: Boise adopts 2018 IBC/IRC/IECC, 2017 Idaho State Plumbing Code, 2023 NEC (4/26/24), applying to projects submitted on or after 2021-01-01 (rev 4/2024 page, still current Oct 2026); 1-2 family mechanical is IRC Parts V-VI.
